Hi Asha / Devon — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything on one thread. Please confirm anything I missed or that you want us to prioritize differently.

TL;DR
- Primary pain: token cost and unpredictable latency spikes during peak batch processing (affecting RAG query-based workflows).
- Goal: reduce per-inference cost ~30% while keeping 95p latency < 250ms for user-facing requests.
- Proposal: 4-week pilot (dedicated small GPU pool + caching + quantization + embeddings batching) to validate cost/latency improvements.

What we heard (pain points):
- Long RAG contexts (~6–9k tokens) cause high per-call compute.
- Occasional 95p latency spikes during end-of-day syncs affect UX SLAs.
- Embeddings load is growing; current shard/batch approach is manual and adds operational overhead.

Goals you called out:
1) Baseline cost and 95/99 latency for current traffic profile (we'll instrument per-route).
2) A measurable plan to reduce tokens/cost without regressing accuracy for legal/clinical extraction flows.
3) Clear procurement timeline and one-point-of-contact for SOC2/contract questions.

Our recommended pilot scope (4 weeks):
- Deploy a dedicated 2x A100-style GPU pool for your RAG and embedding workloads (isolated to avoid noisy neighbors).
- Enable prefix/KV caching on the 90% repeatable queries and auto-batching for embeddings to reduce calls.
- Evaluate 4-bit quantized variant for the RAG model on a shadowed set of queries (safety check + quality evals).
- Instrument token and latency telemetry and run weekly checkpoints (we'll deliver a short report each week).

Deliverables and timeline
- Week 0 (this week): pilot SOW + DocuSign MSA, SOC2 evidence packet (attached), kickoff scheduling.
- Week 1: baseline capture and config tuning (batching/caching policy).
- Week 2–3: run experiments (quantization + routing fallbacks), measure quality on your prompt set.
- Week 4: final report with cost delta, latency SLOs, recommended next steps for Dedicated or Hybrid routing.

Asks from Polaris:
- Confirm pilot acceptance and PO/contract owner for procurement.
- Share 2–3 representative prompt sets we should use for quality evals (redact PHI as needed).
- Confer whether embeddings consolidation should be in-scope or a follow-on.
